Welcome to UIU Debate Club

United International University Debate Club (UIUDC) was formed on February 14, 2004. It is one of the oldest clubs of UIU and one of the top debate clubs of the country. UIUDC has a long heritage of success in the debate arena from the last 18 Years. The objective of UIUDC is to create and nurture debaters, bearing the flag of UIU nationwide in the prestigious debating tournaments. UIU debate team has participated in different international tournaments in Malaysia, Philippine, Berlin (Germany), Oxford IV, and Cambridge IV etc.
